name: @playform/ets-client-dsh-panel-family-host
description: The host half of the UI family's panel: the companion package that gives the central panel LIVE data and its ONE trusted write surface (Documentation/Plans/UI-Family/PHASE-5-ADAPTERS-AND-LEDGER-TAILS.md, PHASE-7-PLAIN-FIELD-BRIDGE.md). Three services. READ-ONLY: tail(namespace, lines) returns the last N lines of the owning module's ~/.dsh log (the family ledger tails) and stats() returns the CCR store summary; the fiberPhases come from the already-remote remote.pluginManager (PHASE-5 step 1: prefer the existing remote). WRITE, least privilege: panelFamilyBridge.editFull(namespace, patch) applies the namespace's WHOLE resolved config through ctx.configEditor.edit() - the plain-field bridge - and REFUSES a namespace declaring a role("secret") field (the patch would restate a redacted value over the stored secret); the audit line comes from the editor. TRACE: panelFamilyTrace forwards the D5 bus (ctx.trace) as on(kind, listener)/ring(limit); the ./client half re-publishes it as the panel's trace service through the harness's generated playformFamilyPanel Remote namespace. The Typert generation pipeline (TypertRemoteService + @Remote + generated descriptors + the client lib/typert.remote-client artifacts) is documented as not reproducible from an external package (PHASE-5 caveat), so the services ship as plain cordis services and the browser forwarding waits on the generated namespace (the documented residual); the panel keeps its static fallback until then.
